title: Evaluation after coordinate reindexing
statement: Let $e$ be an embedding of the $m$ coordinates into the $n$ coordinates, let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $m$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$. For any input $x$ assigning an alphabet symbol to each of the $n$ coordinates, evaluating the reindexed tree equals evaluating $T$ at the input $i\mapsto x(e(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding e : Fin m ↪ Fin n
A finite set A of available coordinates in Fin m
A finite decision tree over Ω with labels in α and available set A
An input x : Fin n → Ω
